description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'View' within the SuiteCRM Search UI MVC namespace. The class manages a Smarty template object, handles template file setting and retrieval, and provides methods for display and pre-display logic in the search framework.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for search framework views, managing Smarty templates and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view with a specified template file and creates a new Sugar_Smarty instance.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Placeholder method for pre-display logic, intended to be overridden.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the assigned template file using Smarty.

methods.name: getTemplateFile
methods.description: Returns the current template file path.
